card.title: Nintendo Switch Game cartridge not reading Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Game cartridge not reading Repair

claims.statement: Check the game card slot for bent pins and liquid around the cart/headphone/touch connector board; replacing that board is complicated by many revisions and firmware lockouts that can kill touch.

procedure: Inspect slot pins and the board for liquid.
Replace board only with a matching revision.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
